articles.title: Nominations to run in Ontario’s fall municipal elections close today
articles.summary: A clearer picture of the choices Ontarians will face at the ballot box is set to emerge this afternoon as nominations for the fall municipal elections come to a close. Would-be candidates have until 2 p.m. to register for the Oct. 26 vote, though some early birds — including mayoral hopefuls in Toronto and Mississauga […]

articles.title: 1 killed in overnight collision that closed Hwy. 403 westbound in Oakville
articles.summary: A section of Hwy. 403 westbound in Oakville was shut down early Friday morning after a serious two‑vehicle collision that left one person dead and another injured, Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) say. articles.title: Another Toronto street festival is being lost to funding shortfalls
articles.summary: The co-founder of the Yorkville Murals festival says they were denied city grants awarded in previous years. More applications are leading to more competition for funding, according to a City of Toronto spokesperson.

articles.title: Halton police say alleged car thief used tracking devices to monitor, steal high-end vehicles
articles.summary: The Halton Regional Police Service (HRPS) alleges a prolific car thief from Quebec was placing tracking devices on high-end vehicles throughout the Greater Toronto Hamilton Area (GTHA) so he could monitor and steal them. articles.title: Scarborough busway opening Sept. 30: TTC
articles.summary: The Scarborough busway, a dedicated transit corridor being built to replace the area's defunct Line 3 train service, is opening Sept. 30, the TTC says.

articles.title: Recently resigned Liberal MP runs for city council in Scarborough North
articles.summary: Recently resigned Liberal MP Shaun Chen is throwing his hat in for a Toronto city council position.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead after crash in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: A man has died in hospital after a motorcycle crash in Scarborough Wednesday evening, police said.

articles.title: Toronto councillor Paula Fletcher announces retirement from municipal politics
articles.summary: Toronto city councillor Paula Fletcher says she is retiring from city hall and will not seek re-election in the October municipal election.

articles.title: Botched opening day of Markham Indy race forces race president to apologize
articles.summary: The president of the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham is proud of how the event came together, but he's sorry that most fans went home disappointed after the event's opening day.
